content.text:
I found **14 of the 92 households** with a single-company stock above their IPS limit, an asset class outside its band, or both, as of 15 April 2026. None has a documented, client-signed exception in the CRM. The other 78 households are within their limits.

**How I checked.** For each household I took the 15 April 2026 position values and cash from `portfolio/positions.json`. I classified each security using the household's own IPS mapping and measured each share against total value (positions plus cash), as the policy requires. For the 8 households I compared against the custodian files (all 4 concentration cases plus 3462, 3058, 8312 and 8865), the custodian's positions and cash match the portfolio system. For all 92, position counts match, and no unsettled cash is reported on 15 April. Every security held appears in its household's IPS mapping.

I searched every CRM file for anything that could be an exception, however worded. There is none: the CRM entries are only agreements, annual reviews, RSU release confirmations, death notices, RMD/QCD instructions and householding letters.

**Single-company stock above the concentration limit**

| Household | Stock | Share of household | IPS limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| HH-0816 | Halvern Health Holdings (SEC-0005) | 49.07% | 20% |
| HH-0221 | Varrick Pharma Holdings (SEC-0040) | 40.29% | 25% |
| HH-0376 | Fenwright Networks Group (SEC-0032) | 37.71% | 30% |
| HH-0984 | Ardley Rail Group (SEC-0048) | 35.75% | 30% |
| HH-3058 | Bramwell Devices Group (SEC-0028) | 32.49% | 15% |

All five hold stock from RSU vesting, with shares going into a stock-plan account. HH-3058 is also outside all three asset-class bands.

**Asset classes outside their bands**

| Household | Outside band (actual vs. allowed range) | What the records show |
|---|---|---|
| HH-3058 | US equity 68.11% (55–65); International equity 4.11% (6–14); Fixed income 15.04% (23–33) | Bramwell Devices Group sale left $439,841 in cash |
| HH-3462 | Fixed income 17.75% (25–35) | Ellisar Search Holdings sale left $430,396 in cash; Ellisar Search Holdings itself is only 6.64% (limit 15%) |
| HH-8312 | US equity 72.06% (50–60); Fixed income 27.01% (35–45) | Joint owner died June 2025; no trades since |
| HH-8865 | US equity 70.71% (50–60); Fixed income 28.47% (35–45) | Joint owner died May 2025; no trades since |
| HH-5271 | US equity 56.12% (45–55); Fixed income 32.42% (35–45) | Bonds sold to fund RMDs |
| HH-5814 | US equity 55.89% (45–55); Fixed income 32.96% (35–45) | Bonds sold to fund RMDs |
